richiami.difetto: The pipe connection on the non return valve fitted to the park brake circuit may separate from the connector due to a manufacturing defect. This could cause unintended application of the parking brake.
richiami.rimedio: Fit a replacement quality assured non return valve.
richiami.titolo: PIPE CONNECTED TO NON RETURN VALVE ON PARKING BRAKE MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: The  studs securing the front and rear brake chambers may have received the incorrect heat treatment. As a consequence a brake chamber could become detached from it's mounting bracket.
richiami.rimedio: Check and replace the front and rear brake chambers where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE CHAMBER MAY BECOME DETACHED FROM MOUNTING BRACKET
